Āḷavakassa.g: ettha pana ayamanupubbikathā–Āḷavako kira rājā vividhanāṭakūpabhogaṁ chaḍḍetvā corapaṭibāhanatthaṁ paṭirājanisedhanatthaṁ byāyāmakaraṇatthañca sattame sattame divase migavaṁ gacchanto ekadivasaṁ balakāyena saddhiṁ katikaṁ akāsi “yassa passena migo palāyati, tasseva so bhāro”ti.

Āḷavakassa.g: yattha abhilakkhitesu maṅgaladivasādīsu āḷavako nisīditvā siriṁ anubhoti, tasmiṁyeva dibbaratanapallaṅke nisīdi.

Āḷavako.g: hatthato hatthaṁ gatattā evaṁladdhanāmo Āḷavako rājaputto.

āḷavakayuddhaṁ.g: so kira manosilātale vāmapādena ṭhatvā “passatha dāni tumhākaṁ vā satthā mahānubhāvo, ahaṁ vā”ti dakkhiṇapādena saṭṭhiyojanamattaṁ kelāsakūṭapabbataṁ akkami, taṁ ayokūṭappahato viya niddhanta-ayapiṇḍo papaṭikāyo muñci.
